title: Check and Explain Equation Solutions Core Test
description: Check proposed solutions in original equations and explain whether solving steps preserve equality.

questions.questionText: Does x = 5 solve 4x + 3 = 2x + 13?
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, both sides equal 23.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: Does x = -2 solve 3x - 4 = x - 8?
options: No, only the left side is -10.
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, both sides equal -10.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: A student solves 2(x + 3) = 18 by writing 2x + 3 = 18. What is the first mistake?
options: They did not distribute 2 to both terms.
questions.correctAnswer: They did not distribute 2 to both terms.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: A student solves 5x + 7 = 2x + 19 by subtracting 2x to get 3x + 7 = 19. Is this step valid?
options: No, variable terms cannot move sides.
No, they should divide by 3 first.
Yes, subtracting 2x from both sides keeps the equation equivalent.
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, subtracting 2x from both sides keeps the equation equivalent.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: Which check proves x = 4 solves 3x + 1 = x + 9?
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: A student changes 1/2x = 6 to x = 6/2. What should they do instead?
options: Divide both sides by 2 to get x = 3.
Multiply both sides by 2 to get x = 12.
questions.correctAnswer: Multiply both sides by 2 to get x = 12.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.

questions.questionText: Which statement best explains why x = 3 does not solve 8x + 1 = 5x + 16?
options: The left side is 24 and the right side is 15.
The left side is 25 and the right side is 31.
questions.correctAnswer: The left side is 25 and the right side is 31.
questions.explanation: A solution must make the original equation true, and every solving step must preserve equality.
